description: Runs the stack's native tools and returns structured results (counts, failing tests with file/line, diagnostics). checks: test (default), typecheck, lint, build, ui. Checks whose tool isn't installed are reported as skipped, never as passed. ui audits a page instead of code (target: a prototype name, an .html file or a http://localhost dev server): static rules always, plus phone/desktop and light/dark rendering with screenshots when Playwright is installed.

agent.description: The agent role making this call (e.g. "dev", "qa", "e2e"), so its work is attributed to it. Defaults to HEXACORE_AGENT.

cwd.description: Project directory relative to the workspace (default: where the stack was detected)

scope.description: Extra runner arguments, e.g. a test file or filter

target.description: For the ui check: a prototype name (default: the latest), an .html file or a http://localhost URL

name: run_quality_assurance
title: Run quality checks
